name: Cerebras Systems
ai_focus: AI computing and generative AI acceleration

timeline.event: Carnegie Endowment reported that G42, MBZUAI, and Cerebras agreed to establish a national-scale AI supercomputer in India.

briefing: Gulf News reports that G42 and Cerebras co-developed a chip with 4 trillion transistors, showcased by Sheikh Saif at WGS 2026 [1]. Core42’s U.S. deployments include Condor Galaxy supercomputers developed in collaboration with Cerebras, across sites including Buffalo, Dallas, Sunnyvale, Stockton, and Minneapolis [2]. Khaleej Times reports that Core42 expected to deploy nearly 40,000 GPUs globally by year-end, supported by architectures including Cerebras systems [3]. G42 said its technology collaborations with U.S. chipmakers include Cerebras, alongside projects such as Stargate UAE [4]. The K2 Think announcement said the model would be available on Cerebras’ wafer-scale inference platform and described a planned throughput of 2,000 tokens per second using speculative decoding optimized for Cerebras hardware [5]. Carnegie Endowment reported that G42, MBZUAI, and Cerebras agreed to establish a national-scale AI supercomputer in India [6].
